name: Broadside
avoid_for: Decks that need to feel quiet, warm, or institutionally traditional — the dark canvas with fire-orange accent commits to drama
weak_cases: Long evidence paragraphs undermine the declaration rhythm; faded supporting lists still need legibility.
visual_signature: Lowercase sans declarations, uppercase mono chrome, dark documentation and orange declaration.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Lowercase/uppercase contrast is not portable to caseless scripts; replace the role distinction consciously.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
